items.name: GB200 NVL72
items.note: 72 颗 Blackwell GPU + 36 颗 Grace CPU，Oberon 机柜，NVLink 72 卡全互联。计算和交换托盘液冷，其余部分仍需风冷。NVIDIA 给出整柜约 120 kW 的冷却需求，Vertiv 参考设计按每柜最高 132 kW 设计；QCT 资料中液冷约 115 kW、风冷约 17 kW，液冷比例按 85% 取整。价格约 $3M（Wolfe Research，2026-01）。

en.note: 72 Blackwell GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs in an Oberon rack, all 72 GPUs connected by NVLink. Compute and switch trays are liquid-cooled; the rest still needs air cooling. NVIDIA gives about 120 kW of cooling per rack, and Vertiv's reference design supports up to 132 kW; QCT lists about 115 kW to liquid and 17 kW to air, rounded here to 85% liquid. About $3M per rack (Wolfe Research, 2026-01).

en.note: Blackwell Ultra version in the same rack form factor as GB200. NVIDIA's reference architecture gives up to 142 kW per rack, Supermicro configures 132 kW, and Lenovo lists 135 kW TDP (about 155 kW peak) with about 90% of the heat going to liquid. About $4.3M per rack (Wolfe Research, 2026-01).

en.note: 72 Rubin GPUs + 36 Vera CPUs with HBM4 and NVLink 6, shipping in the second half of 2026. Compute trays are fanless and NVIDIA says the racks can be 100% liquid-cooled. NVIDIA has not published rack power: Ming-Chi Kuo's supply chain checks put Max-Q at about 190 kW and Max-P at about 230 kW (2026-01); this uses Max-Q. Quoted at about $5–7M per rack, including about $1M of storage (Tom's Hardware, 2026-03).

items.name: CloudMatrix 384 计算柜
items.note: 华为 Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD（华为云称 CloudMatrix384）的计算柜。整套 16 柜：12 个计算柜，每柜 4 个节点、共 32 颗昇腾 910C NPU（这里按 GPU 计，同样要占 IB 交换柜的后端端口）；4 个总线交换柜承载全光 UnifiedBus 超节点互联（6,912 个 LPO 光模块），这里不单独建模，功耗和价格摊进计算柜。计算柜液冷、总线柜风冷（华为）。整套约 559 kW，含网络和存储（SemiAnalysis 经 Tom's Hardware，2025-04），约 $8M（FT 经 TrendForce，2025-07）；每柜功耗、液冷比例和价格都是按整套平摊的估算。2025 年 3 月开始交付；后续的 Atlas 950 SuperPoD 每个计算柜 64 颗 NPU、约 100 kW，计划 2026 年四季度上市。

en.name: CloudMatrix 384 rack
en.note: Compute rack of Huawei's Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD (offered by Huawei Cloud as CloudMatrix384). A full system is 16 racks: 12 compute racks, each with 4 nodes and 32 Ascend 910C NPUs (counted as GPUs here, so they need back-end ports on IB switch racks too), and 4 bus switch racks carrying the all-optical UnifiedBus scale-up network (6,912 LPO transceivers). The switch racks are not modeled separately; their power and price are folded into the compute racks. Compute racks are liquid-cooled and switch racks air-cooled (Huawei). The whole system draws about 559 kW including networking and storage (SemiAnalysis via Tom's Hardware, 2025-04) and costs about $8M (FT via TrendForce, 2025-07); per-rack power, liquid share and price spread those totals over the 12 compute racks and are estimates. Deliveries began in March 2025; the successor Atlas 950 SuperPoD puts 64 NPUs and about 100 kW in each compute cabinet and is planned for Q4 2026.

items.name: Quantum-X800 IB
items.note: 800G InfiniBand 交换机柜。一台 Quantum-X800 Q3400 交换机有 144 个 800G 端口，典型功耗约 2.9 kW、最大 7 kW（NVIDIA）。这里每柜按两台交换机算：288 个端口、24 kW（含光模块等余量）。开机检查按每个 GPU 至少占一个端口计算；无阻塞的两层胖树每个 GPU 约占三个交换机端口（叶交换机上下行各一个、脊交换机一个），见“后端网络”一节。价格为估算。

en.note: 800G InfiniBand switch rack. One Quantum-X800 Q3400 switch has 144 ports at 800G and draws about 2.9 kW typical, 7 kW maximum (NVIDIA). Each rack is counted as two switches: 288 ports and 24 kW including optics and overhead. The power-on check counts at least one port per GPU; a non-blocking two-tier fat tree uses about three switch ports per GPU (one down and one up on a leaf, one on a spine), see Back-end fabric. The price is an estimate.
